name: retail-kpi
description: Logo Tiger tabanlı bağımsız perakende KPI platformu

scripts.migration:check: docker compose run --rm --no-deps --build api node apps/api/dist/database/schema-check.js
scripts.migration:revert: docker compose run --rm --no-deps --build api node apps/api/node_modules/typeorm/cli.js -d apps/api/dist/database/data-source.js migration:revert
scripts.migration:run: docker compose run --rm --no-deps --build api node apps/api/node_modules/typeorm/cli.js -d apps/api/dist/database/data-source.js migration:run
scripts.migration:show: docker compose run --rm --no-deps --build api node apps/api/node_modules/typeorm/cli.js -d apps/api/dist/database/data-source.js migration:show
